profile.instruct: Speak warmly and clearly, like a kindergarten English teacher. Use a gentle, encouraging tone and careful pronunciation.

wordbankJobs.text: airplane
We watched the airplane take off at the airport.
Please turn your mobile phones to airplane mode during flight.
A supersonic research airplane crossed the horizon, leaving behind a faint white contrail in the stratosphere.
This is a large machine that carries people through the sky. It has wings and an engine. It can take travelers to far places.
People ride inside this flying machine to reach another city or country. Its wings help it stay in the air. A pilot guides it.
This kind of transport travels above the ground. It can carry many passengers across long distances. The crew helps guide the trip.
airport
Taoyuan International Airport is very busy.
We arrived at the airport two hours before our flight.
An airport express train links the terminal directly to the city center.
This is a place where people go to begin or end a trip by air. Travelers check bags there. They wait for their flight to leave.
A large travel center has places for planes to stop. People arrive there before flying away. Signs help them find their gate.
This place has runways and buildings for air travel. Travelers meet the crew and board their flight there. Families may also wait there to welcome someone.
ask
Feel free to ask questions if you don't understand.
The tourist asked the police officer for directions to Taipei 101.
Can I ask you for a small favor?
It means to say something because you want information. It can also mean requesting someone to do something. The person may answer or help.
Use this word when you want someone to tell you something. It may also be a polite way to request help. A student may seek advice from a teacher.
This word describes speaking to get information or help. It can also mean making a request. The other person may give a reply or do the task.
bag
Put your homework in your school bag.
She packed her travel bag for the weekend trip.
Please don't forget to bring a reusable shopping bag.
This is a container used for carrying things. It may have handles or a zipper. Students often use one to carry books.
People put small items inside this container. It may be made of paper, cloth, or leather. A traveler can carry it by hand or on a shoulder.
This word names a soft or firm container. It can hold food, school supplies, or personal items. Some kinds close with a zipper.
bell
The school bell rang at the end of class.
A small bell hung above the shop door.
Ring the bell if you need help.
This is a small object that makes a clear sound when it moves. Schools may use one to mark the start or end of class. A person may ring it to get someone’s attention.
It is a sound-making object found on doors, bikes, or desks. Someone can move it to make a ringing sound. A school may use one to tell students when class changes.
This object can make a bright ringing noise. It may hang near a door or sit on a counter. People use its sound to call someone.
bench
We sat on a bench beside the playground.
The coach asked the players on the bench to stand up.
My grandfather built a wooden bench for the garden.
This is a long seat for two or more people. It may stand in a park or near a sports field. A judge may also work at a raised desk with this name.
People can sit together on this kind of seat. It is often made of wood or metal. In sports, it can name the place where extra players wait.
This word can name a long seat without arms. It may be found outside or in a hall. It can also mean a high work seat used by a judge.
boat
We took a boat tour around Sun Moon Lake.
The fishermen returned to port with their small wooden boats.
A rowing boat is available for rent in the park.
The boat is slow.
This is a small vehicle that travels on water. People may use it for fishing or crossing a lake. It can move with a motor, oars, or sails.
People ride in this watercraft on rivers, lakes, or the sea. It may carry a few people or many. A person can guide it with oars or a motor.
This word names a craft that floats on water. Some are small enough for one family. Others carry people or goods from place to place.
busy
Dad is busy preparing for his morning presentation.
Zhongxiao East Road is one of the busiest streets in Taipei.
I am too busy this week to join the weekend hiking trip.
It describes someone who has many things to do. A person may not have much free time. A shop can also have many customers.
Use this word when a person is working or doing tasks. It can describe a place with many people. A full day may leave little time to rest.
This word tells that someone has a lot to do. It may describe a street full of activity. People may say they are this way during a hard week.
carry
Let me help you carry those heavy grocery bags.
Most airline passengers are permitted to carry one bag onto the plane.
She always carries an umbrella in her backpack just in case it rains.
It means holding something and taking it to another place. A child may move books in their arms. A bag can hold items while someone travels.
Use this word when moving an object with your hands or on your body. A person may take groceries home. It can also mean supporting an idea or message.
This verb tells that someone moves something from one place to another. They may hold it or put it in a bag. A vehicle can also take people or goods.
check
Double check your test answers before handing it in.
Hotel guests can check in at the reception desk starting from 3:00 PM.
The technician arrived early to check the building's fire alarms.
It means looking at something to see if it is right. It can also name a mark placed beside a correct answer. In some places, it names a paper used to pay money.
Use this word when you inspect a list or answer. A small mark may show that something is done. It may also name a way to pay from a bank account.
This word can mean examining something closely. It can name a tick mark on a form. A written payment paper may have this name too.
clock
The clock on the wall says 3:00 PM.
My alarm clock rang loudly at six this morning.
The convenience store is open around the clock.
This device shows the time. It may hang on a wall or sit on a desk. Some make a sound each hour.
People look at this object to know the hour and minute. It may have hands or a digital screen. A large one may stand in a town square.
This word names something that measures time. It can be worn, hung, or placed on a desk. Its face may show numbers.
cloud
White clouds are floating across the sky.
Dark clouds gathered quickly before the summer storm.
You can store your documents and photos securely in the cloud.
This is a white or gray shape made of tiny drops high in the sky. It may bring rain. Wind can move it across the sky.
A soft-looking mass floats above the ground. It may hide the sun or turn dark before a storm. Some are thin, while others look large and puffy.
This word names a group of water drops in the sky. It can shade the ground. Dark ones may bring rain or snow.
coffee
My mother drinks a cup of black coffee every morning.
The smell of freshly brewed coffee filled the kitchen.
I prefer iced coffee over hot coffee in summer.
This is a dark drink made from roasted seeds. Many people drink it in the morning. It can be served hot or cold.
People make this drink by pouring hot water through ground seeds. It may taste strong or mild. Milk or sugar can be added.
This word names a popular drink from a tropical plant. The roasted seeds give it a rich taste. It may help people feel more awake.
comfortable
This memory foam mattress provides a comfortable night's sleep.
Wear loose, comfortable clothing when taking long-distance international flights.
Are you feeling comfortable with the proposed project timeline?
It describes something that feels easy and pleasant. A soft chair may help someone relax. A person may feel at ease with close friends.
Use this word for a seat or bed that feels good. It can also describe feeling calm with another person. Soft clothes may feel nice on the skin.
This word tells that someone feels relaxed or free from pain. It may describe furniture or clothing. A friendly place may make a guest feel this way.
cup
Would you like a hot cup of black tea?
He won first prize and proudly held the championship cup.
Place a cup of water beside the bed before sleeping.
This is a small container for drinking. It often has a handle. A winner may also receive a metal prize with this name.
People fill this container with tea, water, or juice. It may be made of glass or ceramic. Sports winners may hold a prize shaped like one.
This word names a drinking vessel with sides. It can also mean a prize given to a winning team. The vessel may have one handle.
drink
Do not drink cold drinks too fast.
Would you like something warm to drink?
You should drink plenty of water after exercising.
It means taking liquid into the mouth and swallowing it. It can also name the liquid people have with a meal. Water is a common one.
Use this word for swallowing water, juice, or milk. It may also mean a cup of liquid. People need enough of it each day.
This verb describes taking liquid into the body. The noun names something people may have with food. It can be hot or cold.
eat
Let's eat lunch together at noon.
Remember to wash your hands before you eat.
We decided to eat out at a nearby noodle shop tonight.
It means putting food into the mouth and swallowing it. People do this to get energy. A meal is a time when they may do it.
Use this verb when someone has food. A person may chew fruit or bread. The body uses food to grow and stay strong.
This action means taking food into the body through the mouth. People may do it at set times each day. Good food helps the body work well.
friendly
The local Taiwanese villagers are exceptionally friendly.
The user-friendly interface makes the mobile app easy for elderly users to navigate.
A warm and friendly greeting sets a welcoming atmosphere for newcomers.
Purchasing eco-friendly rice grown without pesticides preserves a pesticide-free feeding ground for leopard cats.
Wildlife-friendly tea plantations install perches that attract insect-eating birds naturally.
Friendly neighborhood volunteers rescue injured raptors and transport them to wildlife rehabilitation clinics.
It describes someone who is kind and easy to talk to. A warm smile may show this quality. It can also describe a place or service that welcomes people.
Use this word for a person who treats others well. A helpful worker may have this manner. A town may make visitors feel welcome.
This word tells that someone is warm and kind. It may describe an animal that is gentle. It can also mean good for the natural world.
gate
Please meet me right at the school gate.
Flight CI100 is boarding immediately at departure gate B5.
Always remember to lock the iron garden gate securely when leaving.
Passengers boarding for Tokyo should proceed to Gate B7.
Don't forget to close and lock the front garden gate.
Boarding will conclude ten minutes before the flight gate closes.
Boarding gate B7 has announced the final call for passengers on flight CI008.
Check the electronic departure board frequently because your flight departure gate might change.
Passengers gathered near the boarding gate as priority boarding for families with toddlers began.
Executing a two-qubit CNOT gate creates maximum entanglement between neighboring superconducting loops.
Applying a single-qubit Hadamard gate puts an initialized zero qubit into an equal superposition.
Minimizing gate execution duration prevents ambient thermal noise from corrupting delicate computations.
This is a movable barrier at the entrance to a fence or wall. It can control who enters. An airport uses the same word for the place where people board a plane.
People open this entrance to go into a yard. It may have a lock. At a travel terminal, signs point to the area where passengers wait to board.
This word names a door in a fence. It may also mean a boarding area at an airport. A guard may open or close it.
give
Give me a hand with these heavy boxes.
She gave her younger brother an inspiring storybook for his birthday.
Never give up on your dreams no matter how tough things get.
It means handing something to another person. Someone may pass a book to a friend. It can also mean offering help or sharing information.
Use this verb when one person lets another have something. A teacher may offer advice. A parent may hand a snack to a child.
This word means transferring something to another person. It may be an object, a chance, or a message. People can also offer time or help.
heavy
The backpack is too heavy for the little boy.
Heavy rain caused localized flooding on the downtown streets.
Heavy traffic on Friday afternoon delayed our trip to Taichung.
Heavy traffic delayed our arrival at the station.
Heavy rains during monsoon season replenished the island's water reservoirs.
The student carried a heavy backpack filled with science textbooks and supplies.
It describes something that weighs a lot. A large box may need two people to lift it. It can also mean a large amount or strong force.
Use this word for a bag that is hard to carry. Rain may fall in a large amount. A person can feel burdened by serious work.
This word tells that an object has much weight. It can describe strong traffic or rain. A large responsibility may feel this way too.
hold
Please hold my hand while crossing the busy street.
The school will hold its annual sports day next Friday.
Could you hold the elevator door for a moment, please?
It means to grasp something with your hands. You might do this to a cup before taking a drink. It can also mean keeping something in one place for a time.
Use this word when a person grips an object. It may also mean keeping an item safe. As a noun, it can mean a place to put something.
This verb may mean carrying or gripping something. It can describe keeping a promise or plan. The noun can name a space or position.
island
Taiwan is a stunning island known for scenic landscapes.
Green Island and Orchid Island are famous diving destinations.
The small tropical island has pristine white sand beaches.
The large kitchen island serves as a food prep station, breakfast bar, and social hub.
Taiwan is a vibrant Pacific island celebrated worldwide for friendly people and night market delicacies.
Install a sink and pop-up electrical outlets directly into the kitchen island for ultimate convenience.
Expanding rooftop greenery and planting 10,000 native trees combats the oppressive urban heat island effect.
Taiwan is a geographically diverse subtropical island featuring towering mountains and coral reefs.
The open-concept kitchen features a spacious central marble island perfect for meal prep and casual dining.
Cool roofs painted with reflective white coatings help mitigate the suffocating urban heat island effect.
Replacing asphalt parking lots with tree groves reduces the intensity of the summer heat island.
Urban satellite data shows that dense downtown areas suffer from a five-degree heat island penalty.
This is land with water all around it. It may be small or large. People often reach one by boat or plane.
The land sits apart from a larger land area. It may have beaches and hills. People who live there may travel by ferry.
This word names a piece of land surrounded by water. Some have only a few homes. Others are large places with many towns.
juice
I love fresh orange juice with breakfast.
Would you like apple juice or grape juice?
Fresh watermelon juice is very refreshing on hot summer days.
This is liquid from fruit. People may drink it with breakfast. Oranges and apples can make it.
A person may squeeze fruit to get this drink. It can be sweet or sour. Some kinds have bits of fruit inside.
This word names a drink made from fruit. It may be served cold. People can pour it into a glass.
large
They live in a large house near the park.
A large crowd gathered for the game.
The elephant has large ears.
It describes something with a lot of space or a very big size. A family may live in a home with many rooms. It can also describe a number.
Use this word for something bigger than average. A tree may spread wide branches. A group may have many members.
This word means bigger in size or amount. It can describe a room or a crowd. It may also mean important.
leave
The train will leave the platform in ten minutes.
Never leave young children unattended in a parked car.
She applied for three days of annual leave to attend a family wedding.
Employees enjoy thirty days of fully paid annual leave and comprehensive healthcare benefits.
New parents are entitled to flexible parental leave under progressive company wellness policies.
Remember to set up an automated out-of-office email notification before taking annual leave.
It means going away from a place. It can also mean keeping something behind. As a noun, it may name time off work.
Use this word when someone departs. A person may also place an item somewhere and not take it. A worker may take a day away from work.
This verb can mean departing or allowing something to remain. It can describe a person going out. The noun may mean permission to be away from work.
line
Please wait in line behind the yellow line.
Draw a straight line across the paper using a plastic ruler.
Remember to rehearse your spoken lines before tomorrow's drama rehearsal.
This is a long narrow mark. People may wait in an ordered row. As a verb, it can mean waiting in such a row.
A straight mark may be drawn on paper. It can also mean a row of people waiting. The verb means forming such a row.
This word can name a mark from one point to another. It may be a sentence in a song. People can wait one behind another.
meal
We had a hot meal after the game.
The meal included soup and fresh bread.
She cooked a meal for her family.
This is food eaten at one time of day. Breakfast and dinner are examples. People may share it with family or friends.
People prepare and eat this at a table. It may have several foods. A restaurant serves many kinds.
This word names food eaten at one sitting. It can be small or large. A person may cook it for guests.
open
The supermarket is open 24 hours a day.
Please open the front window to let fresh air circulate.
The new library branch will open to the public next Monday.
It can mean moving a door so people can enter. A shop may welcome customers. It can also describe a person who is willing to listen to ideas.
Use this word when a door is not shut. A store may let people come inside. It can also mean ready for use.
This word can describe a clear path or an available choice. A lid may be moved aside. A school or shop may let visitors enter.
pen
Can I borrow your blue pen?
The black pen has run out of ink.
Sign your signature here with this black ink pen.
Get a red pen.
A person uses this tool to write with ink. It may have a cap to keep the tip clean. Some people use it to sign a letter.
This writing tool has a small point. Dark liquid comes from it onto a page. Students may carry one in a bag.
A person holds this tool and moves it across paper. It leaves a colored line. A cap may cover its small writing tip.
plate
Put the sliced fruit on a clean white plate.
She dropped the ceramic plate and it shattered onto the floor.
He finished everything on his plate without wasting food.
Automatic license plate reader networks flagged the stolen SUV within two minutes of passing the toll bridge.
Highway patrol vehicles are equipped with rooftop cameras that read every passing car license plate automatically.
The suspect swapped stolen plate tags onto his vehicle to mislead roadside automated reader networks.
The mainplate serves as the structural foundation supporting all micro-mechanical components.
Waiters cleared empty porcelain dinner plates from the dining table before serving rich chocolate dessert.
Geological tectonic plates shifting along the fault line trigger periodic earthquakes across the island.
People eat food from this flat dish. It may be made of glass or clay. A car also has a metal tag that shows its letters and digits.
A meal may be served on this round object. It can be put in a cupboard after washing. The same word can mean a metal part in a machine or vehicle tag.
This dish holds food at a table. It may be round and shallow. In a car, the word can refer to the tag fixed at the front or back.
ready
Are you ready for the big sports match?
Dinner is ready; please wash your hands and come to the table.
The rescue team stands ready to respond to natural disaster emergencies.
It means prepared for something. A child may have shoes by the door. A meal can also be available to eat.
Use this word for a person who can begin now. A bag may be packed for a trip. It can also describe food made to eat.
This word tells that someone is set to start. A team may wait for a signal. It may describe a thing that can be used now.
rope
The sailor tied the rope to the boat.
We used a strong rope to pull the box.
The climber held the rope tightly.
It is a thick cord made from twisted strands. People tie things with it. A climber may use one for safety.
This long strong cord can hold a boat. A person can tie a knot in it. Workers may use it to lift something heavy.
Many thin strands are twisted together to make this. It may help pull a bucket from a well. A sailor uses it to secure a boat.
sea
We took a scenic ferry ride across the sea.
The blue sea sparkled brilliantly under the bright sunlight.
Many fishermen depend on the sea for their livelihood.
A huge body of salt water covers much of Earth. Ships travel across it. Fish and whales live in it.
Waves move along this wide body of water. A beach may be beside it. Many kinds of fish live there.
This large water body is salty. It may look blue or gray. A boat can carry goods across it.
seat
Please fasten your seatbelt and take your seat.
She kindly gave up her subway seat to an elderly pregnant woman.
You can reserve your cinema seat online to get the best viewing angle.
People sit on this object in a room. A bus has many of them. As a verb, it can mean helping someone sit down.
A chair has a place for one person. A theater may have many in lines. A host may help a guest sit.
This object may be found at a table. A person can sit in it. It can also mean giving someone a place to sit.
ship
A huge cargo ship entered the harbor.
The company will ship your order within two business days.
We took a luxury cruise ship to explore the Mediterranean islands.
A large boat carries people or goods across water. It can travel across the sea. A sailor may work on one.
This vessel can move across an ocean. It may carry cars or boxes. A crew helps it travel safely.
A boat of great size may take a long trip. A captain leads its crew. It can carry many people or goods.
show
The children watched a puppet show.
Can you show me how to use this tool?
The shop will show new toys in the window.
People watch a story, event, or skill. A teacher may use pictures in class. It can also mean guiding something to someone.
A theater lets people watch a performance. A chart can make facts clear. The word may also mean guiding a guest to a seat.
This word can mean a performance for an audience. A person can use it to explain how a tool works. A store may put goods in a window.
sign
Please sign your name on the dotted line.
Dark clouds in the sky are a sure sign of rain.
He didn't see the stop sign and ran through the intersection.
A mark can give information or directions. A person may write their name on paper. The same word can mean making a mark with a hand.
A road has a board with words for drivers. A shop may put a notice in its window. As an action, this word can mean writing a name.
A symbol may tell people where to go. It can show a rule or warning. A person may use a hand to show an idea.
sit
Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
We sat by the window watching the raindrops fall into the garden.
Sit up straight during class to prevent back pain and fatigue.
The pig can sit.
It means resting on a chair with the body upright. A person may do this at a desk. A dog can do it when told.
A child can be on a chair during a lesson. The body is lower than when standing. A cat may stay in this position by a window.
This position uses a chair or bench. A person may stay still during a meal. A teacher may ask a class to do this.
sunny
We had a picnic on a sunny Sunday.
It was a bright and sunny morning without a cloud in sight.
Sunny days always lift people's spirits and energy.
It describes weather with lots of sunshine. People may wear light clothes outside. The sky may look bright and clear.
A clear day can feel warm. A person may use glasses to block the bright light. This word tells that the weather is bright.
This describing word means full of sunshine. A picnic may happen in such weather. Plants get light from above.
tea
Would you like some hot green tea?
Black tea with milk is a classic breakfast drink.
In Taiwan, tea culture has a very long history.
A warm drink is made by soaking leaves in hot water. People may drink it with milk or lemon. It can be served in a cup.
A person may have this drink with breakfast. Green and black kinds come from leaves. A pot can hold enough for a family.
This hot drink may help a person relax. A bag of dried leaves goes into a cup. Some people add honey.
ticket
Do you have your train ticket ready?
Concert tickets sold out within two minutes of going on sale.
Scan the QR code on your mobile ticket at the automatic turnstile gate.
People show this paper or card before entering a place. A bus rider may buy one. It may also let someone see a movie.
A small paper gives permission to travel. A person may keep it in a wallet. A gate worker checks it before entry.
This item may have a seat number. A passenger needs one for a trip. A theater may sell one at its door.
towel
Dry your hands with a clean towel.
Hang the wet bath towel outside in the sun to dry.
Bring an extra beach towel when you visit the swimming pool.
People dry their bodies with this soft cloth after bathing. It can soak up water. A beach bag may hold one.
A person may wrap one around wet hair. It is made from cloth. A kitchen may have a smaller one for dishes.
This fabric item helps dry hands and body. It may hang near a sink. A swimmer can carry one to the pool.
uniform
The students wore a blue uniform.
His school uniform has a white shirt.
The nurse put on her uniform before work.
People who do the same job may wear matching clothes. A school may require one for each student. It can show membership in a group.
A team wears matching clothing. A nurse may have special work clothes. The word can mean making things alike.
This clothing shows a person’s group or job. Students may put it on each day. It often has the same color and design for all.
wait
Please wait here until your number is called.
I cannot wait to see my best friend after summer vacation.
We waited patiently in line for the popular bakery to open.
It means staying in one place until something happens. A person may remain at a bus stop. The word can also mean a period of delay.
A child may remain near the door. A friend may arrive later. This word can mean expecting someone or something.
This action means not leaving yet. A person may remain in a line. It can also mean putting something off.
watch
My dad bought me a digital watch.
Do you want to watch a movie with us tonight?
Watch out for cars when you cross the street!
A person looks at a clock to know the hour. They may also see a show on a screen. The word can mean keeping guard.
A child may look at birds in a tree. A person can see a movie at home. The word also names a small clock worn on a wrist.
This action uses the eyes for a period. A person may keep guard at night. It can also mean following a game.
water
Remember to drink plenty of water every day.
Don't forget to water the plants on the balcony.
Can I have a glass of cold water, please?
It is a clear liquid people drink. Rivers and lakes hold it. Rain falls from clouds.
A person may drink this after running. A bath can be filled with it. Plants need it to grow.
This liquid has no color or smell. It comes from a tap. A person can freeze it into ice.
wave
Massive colliding black holes send catastrophic ripples of gravitational waves vibrating across the cosmos.
Surfers paddled furiously to catch the gigantic rolling wave crashing onto the sandy coastline.
The government announced a supportive wave of renewable energy subsidies for rural solar cooperatives.
A moving line of water travels across a lake or sea. It can rise and fall. A hand can also move from side to side to greet someone.
People may see this motion on the ocean. A flag can move in the wind. A person may lift a hand in greeting.
This word can mean a moving line of water. It can also mean moving a hand or arm. A radio can send signals through the air.
wide
The river is wide near the bridge.
She opened the wide gate.
The table is too wide for this room.
It means having a large distance from left to right. A river can be hard to cross. A road may have many lanes.
A door can have a large opening from side to side. A smile may stretch across a face. The word describes a great width.
This word means broad. A table may have a large surface. It can describe something that covers a lot from one side to another.
window
Open the window to let fresh air in.
The cat is sitting quietly by the living room window.
Raindrops are tapping gently against the bedroom window.
The planetary launch window opens every twenty-six months when Earth and Mars align favorably in orbit.
Missing the tight launch window forces flight planners to postpone interplanetary missions by two full years.
Propulsion engineers calculated an optimal departure window to take full advantage of orbital alignment.
A clear opening in a wall lets light enter. People can look outside through it. Curtains may cover it.
A house has glass panels that can open. A bird may sit on its outer ledge. A person may close it during a storm.
This part of a room lets people see outdoors. It may have curtains or blinds. A frame holds its glass.
board
The teacher wrote on the board.
She joined the school board last year.
A wooden board covered the hole.
The board is in the store.
Students write on a flat surface in a classroom. A person may also serve on a group that makes decisions. The word can mean a flat piece of wood.
A teacher may write with chalk on one. A group of leaders may meet as a committee. The word can also mean a piece of wood.
This flat item can cover a wall. A class may use it for lessons. People may sit on a group of directors.
empty
The water bottle is empty; please refill it.
The classroom was empty after the final school bell rang.
Don't take strong medication on an empty stomach without consulting a doctor.
It means having nothing inside. A box may have no toys. A room can have no people.
A glass may have no water. A person can remove everything from a bag. The word can also be an action.
This word describes a container with nothing in it. A person may clear a table. A hall can have no furniture.
engine
The mechanic checked the car engine thoroughly.
Strange rattling noises came from the old aircraft engine.
Turn off the engine while waiting at the railway crossing.
The blue-glowing xenon ion engine produces gentle, continuous thrust for years using solar electricity.
Multiple Hall-effect thruster engines fired in sequence to steer the robotic asteroid redirect spacecraft.
Operating the high-efficiency ion engine requires only a few grams of inert noble gas per day.
The 300kW fuel cell engine powers forty-ton semi-trucks easily up steep mountain highways.
The certified mechanic repaired the automobile engine after diagnosing a cracked cylinder head gasket.
Technological innovation serves as the primary engine driving economic productivity and job growth nationwide.
A car has a machine that makes it move. It uses fuel or electricity. A mechanic may fix it.
A plane has a powerful part that moves it forward. A small machine can run a pump. The word means a machine that provides motion.
This machine turns fuel into movement. It can be found in a car or boat. A driver starts it with a key.
flag
The flag waved in the wind.
Our school flag is blue and white.
The driver was flagged down by a police officer.
A piece of cloth shows a country’s colors. A school may raise one on a pole. A traffic signal can tell drivers what to do.
A nation may have a symbol with colors and shapes. People can wave it at a game. It can also mean giving a warning.
This cloth symbol may fly above a building. A person may hold one in a parade. It can stand for a country or group.
form
Please fill out this form.
Water can form ice in cold weather.
The clouds formed a long line.
This can mean the shape of something. Clay can become a bowl or a cup. Each finished object has a different outline.
This can be a paper with spaces for information. A person writes a name and an address in those spaces. A school may ask a parent to fill it in.
The verb means making or developing something. Children can make a circle by standing together. Clouds can also develop in the sky.
guest
We prepared a warm welcome for our dinner guests.
The luxury resort offers complimentary breakfast and fruit bowls to hotel guests.
A world-famous author appeared as the special guest speaker at the literary seminar.
A person invited to a home or event is this. The host may offer food. A hotel may have many.
A friend may come to stay for a night. The person is invited. A party can have many of them.
This word means a visitor who is invited. A host may greet the person. They may be given a seat and food.
magazine
English learning magazines are very helpful.
She subscribed to a monthly science magazine for young readers.
You can flip through magazines while waiting in the dental clinic.
This English learning magazine features interesting cultural stories.
She subscribed to an interior design magazine to gather home decorating ideas.
The doctor's clinic waiting room provides current news and science magazines.
A book comes out regularly with stories and pictures. A person may read one at a doctor’s office. It can have many pages.
A monthly publication may share news or fashion. A shop sells it. A reader may collect old issues.
This printed book has articles and photos. It can be published each week or month. People may read it for fun.
narrow
The narrow bridge let only one person cross at a time.
We walked along a narrow path beside the garden.
Our team won by a narrow margin.

This adjective describes something with little space from side to side. A road, hallway, or opening may be difficult to pass through when it has this shape. It can also describe a small difference or limited choice.
Two cars may need to slow down on a road between tall walls. A person carrying a wide box might have trouble getting through a small doorway. Careful steps help in a tight space.
A word meaning “wide” describes the opposite shape. A path can be long and still have little side-to-side space. It can also describe a close victory when the score difference is small.
sail
We watched the boat sail across the bay.
The white sail caught the wind.
The ship will sail at dawn.
This verb means to travel on water in a boat, often using wind. As a noun, it names the large cloth that catches wind. The word can also mean moving smoothly.
A family may ride in a small boat across a lake. The wind pushes against the cloth and moves the boat forward. A captain steers around rocks.
A motorboat uses an engine, while a sailboat can use wind. The noun names the cloth, and the verb names the trip. A bird can glide through the air.
sailor
The sailor tied the boat to the dock.
A sailor waved from the deck.
The sailor checked the ropes before leaving.
This noun names a person who works or travels on a ship. Crew members help steer, care for equipment, or move cargo. Some serve in a navy.
A person on a ship may spend weeks at sea with a crew. Another might guide a small boat along the coast. The job requires learning how to stay safe on the water.
A passenger rides on a ship but does not work there. A captain leads the crew. The word can describe people on many kinds of ships.
screen
Staring at the screen for too long hurts your eyes.
Modern smartphone screens adjust brightness automatically according to room lighting.
He installed a protective glass film over the tablet screen.
This noun names the flat surface showing pictures on a phone, computer, or television. It can also mean the cloth used to show a movie. As a verb, it means to check or test.
A student reads a story on a tablet display. People watch a film on a large wall at a theater. A doctor may check for a health problem.
A display shows images but does not create them by itself. A curtain can hide the view. Checking people or things for a reason is another use of the verb.
serve
They serve lunch at noon.
I serve on the school library committee.
She served the ball over the net.
This verb can mean to give food or help to someone. It can also mean working for a group or beginning play in some sports. It has several common uses.
A waiter may bring soup to a table. A tennis player hits the ball to begin a point. A volunteer may help people at a shelter.
This verb can describe helping, providing food, or starting a game. It is often followed by “as” when describing a job. In tennis, that first hit begins play.
soap
Wash your hands with antibacterial soap.
Natural handmade soap is gentle on sensitive skin.
Place the wet soap in a well-drained soap dish.
This cleaning product mixes with water to remove dirt from hands or dishes. It may come as a solid bar or a liquid in a pump bottle. People often wash before eating.
Rubbing creates bubbles that lift grease and dust away. People rinse the bubbles off afterward so the surface feels clean. Rinsing well removes slippery bubbles.
A scented kind can smell like flowers or fruit. Some kinds are made for washing clothes, while others are gentle enough for skin. A mild scent can stay on clean hands.
toothbrush
Dentists recommend changing your toothbrush every three months.
An electric toothbrush removes dental plaque more effectively.
Don't forget to pack your toothbrush before going on vacation.
A small brush with a handle helps clean teeth. People move it gently over each tooth. They use it with toothpaste and water.
Brushes have soft or firm bristles. A clean one should be stored where it can dry. Each person should have their own.
Cleaning teeth every day is part of good care. Replace worn bristles when needed. A clean brush works better.
windy
Hsinchu is known as the windy city.
It is too windy today to go sailing on the lake.
The windy weather made flying a kite easy and fun.
Strong moving air blows outside. Trees bend and leaves fly along the street. A jacket can keep someone warm.
A day with much moving air may be hard for flying a kite. The string pulls strongly. Hold it safely with an adult nearby.
Weather reports describe how much air is moving. Secure light objects in the yard. They could blow away.
wing
The bird hurt its wing and could not fly far.
A small plane lifted its left wing above the trees.
The children's wing of the hospital has bright wall pictures.
A bird uses this body part to fly and keep balance. Feathers cover it. Moving it up and down pushes air.
An airplane has a part with the same name on each side. These parts help lift it into the sky. Pilots check them carefully.
A building may have a side section extending from the main part. A hospital can have one area for children. Signs guide visitors.
cabin
The spacious wide-body aircraft cabin features dynamic circadian mood lighting.
We rented a rustic wooden cabin nestled among the tall pine trees in the mountains.
The airplane cabin pressure is maintained comfortably at an equivalent altitude of 6,000 feet.
A small simple house or room can stand in a forest or near a lake. Travelers may sleep there. It offers shelter from weather.
The front part of an airplane or ship holds the people who control it. They watch instruments. They follow safety steps.
A wooden shelter in the mountains may have beds and a stove. Visitors bring supplies. They leave the place clean.
captain
The captain steered the boat into the quiet harbor.
Our team captain thanked everyone after the final game.
The airplane captain welcomed passengers before takeoff.
A leader is in charge of a ship or airplane. They guide the crew. They check that everyone follows safety rules.
A sports team may choose one player to lead. That person encourages teammates. They speak with the referee when needed.
The leader helps make decisions during a trip or game. Experience can be useful. Listening to others is important too.
cart
Dad pushed the cart through the grocery store.
The farmer loaded apples onto a wooden cart.
I added a notebook to my online cart before checkout.
A small vehicle with wheels carries groceries or other items. Someone pushes it through a store. Keep it out of the way afterward.
A horse or another animal may pull this vehicle. It can carry farm goods. Strong wheels make it easier to move.
A computer shop may show a list of items someone plans to buy. The shopper checks the total before paying. A button removes items no longer needed.
luggage
Weigh your luggage before heading to the airport.
The airline allows two pieces of checked luggage per economy passenger.
Porters helped carry the heavy luggage up to our hotel room.
The bags and cases people take on a trip are called this. They may hold clothes and personal items. Travelers should keep important things close.
Airlines have rules about how much a person can carry. Labels help bags get back to their owners. Check the rules before traveling.
A suitcase is one piece, while this word can refer to all the bags together. A backpack may be part of it too. Pack only what is needed.
passage
We walked through a narrow passage under the old bridge.
Read the passage and answer the questions.
The passage between the buildings was dark.
A narrow way through or between places is called this. A hallway connects rooms inside a building. A cave may have a dark path through it.
A section of writing from a book is also called this. A reader may study a short part closely. It can contain several sentences or paragraphs.
A road is wide enough for vehicles, while a narrow path may be smaller. In a book, it means a selected piece of text. The context shows which sense applies.
passenger
All passengers are required to wear seatbelts by law.
Flight attendants welcomed each passenger aboard the airplane.
Over a thousand passengers boarded the cruise ship for the Caribbean voyage.
A person traveling in a car, bus, train, or plane without driving it is called this. They should wear a seat belt when required. The driver is responsible for the vehicle.
Ships also carry people who are not part of the crew. They may travel to another island. The crew helps keep the trip safe.
A driver controls a vehicle, while this traveler rides in it. On a bus, many people can travel together. Follow safety instructions during the trip.
passport
Remember to bring your valid passport when traveling abroad.
The immigration officer inspected her passport and stamped an entry visa.
Keep your passport in a secure zipper pouch to prevent accidental loss.
Ensure your biometric passport has at least six months of remaining validity.
Keep your passport and cash securely stored inside a zippered neck pouch while traveling.
She proudly showed the colorful border stamps covering the pages of her travel passport.
Every beam and window is logged in a digital material passport to document chemical makeup and recycling value.
Scanning a building component's QR code accesses its material passport detailing reuse instructions.
Digital material passports treat modern buildings as banks of valuable materials for future generations.
English is not just a school subject; it is your golden passport to the boundless global village.
Please check that your biometric passport has at least six months of validity before booking flights.
High emotional intelligence and global cultural literacy serve as an invisible passport across international borders.
An official document proves a person's identity and citizenship when traveling to another country. Officials may check it at a border. Keep it safe during a trip.
The small booklet contains a photo and personal details. It may need to be valid for a certain time before travel. Check requirements early.
A ticket shows a journey was paid for, while this document helps a traveler cross borders. Different countries have their own rules. An adult can help prepare travel papers.
shampoo
This botanical shampoo smells like mint.
Wash your hair with anti-dandruff shampoo twice a week.
She prefers using silicone-free shampoo for healthier hair.
A liquid or cream used to wash hair is called this. People massage it into wet hair and rinse it out. Keep it away from the eyes.
The verb means to wash hair with the product. Some kinds are made for dry or curly hair. Read the label before use.
Soap can clean hands and body, while this product is made especially for hair. Conditioner is used afterward by some people. Rinse well.
tag
The price tag was still attached to the shirt.
The children played tag in the yard.
She tagged the photo with the place name.
A small label attached to an item gives its name, price, or details. Clothes often have one inside. Read it before washing the garment.
As a verb, it can mean touching another player in a game. A child may touch another player during the chasing game. Agree on safe rules first.
A sign may show information for a whole place, while this is often attached to one object. It can also refer to a chasing game. The sentence shows the use.
tray
A carved solid bamboo tea tray drains excess rinse water neatly away beneath its slotted surface.
The flight attendant walked down the airplane aisle balancing a beverage service tray with coffee and juice.
Heavy wooden cafeteria trays were replaced with lightweight, recycled plastic versions.
A flat object with raised edges is used to carry cups or food. A waiter may bring several drinks on it. The edges help stop items from sliding off.
People can also use one to keep small objects together on a desk. It can be made of wood or plastic. Clean it after use.
A plate holds one serving of food, while this flat carrier can hold several items. It is easy to lift with both hands. Keep it level.
reservation
I made a dinner reservation for four at the hot pot restaurant.
You must confirm your table reservation at least one day before dining.
The committee expressed strong reservations about the proposed budget cut.
I made an online hotel reservation for two nights in Kenting.
Because the seafood restaurant is very popular, making a table reservation is mandatory.
You can modify or cancel your booking reservation without penalty up to forty-eight hours in advance.
This can mean an arrangement to keep a place or service ready for someone. A family may book a hotel room before a trip. The hotel holds the room for their arrival.
A restaurant may save a table for guests at a chosen time. The guests give their name when they arrive. The arrangement helps them plan their evening.
The noun can also mean a doubt or concern about a plan. Someone may like most of an idea but worry about its cost. That concern can make them hesitate.
terminal
Taoyuan International Airport features Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
The airport Skytrain carries passengers between terminals in just a few minutes.
The patient was diagnosed with terminal illness, but remained remarkably optimistic.
Taoyuan International Airport is constructing a state-of-the-art Terminal 3.
Take the free airport skytrain to transfer between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
The long-distance coach terminal is located directly next to the central railway station.
Kaohsiung Port Terminal 7 operates Taiwan's first fully automated remote-controlled container yard.
The modern cargo terminal processes import declarations around the clock to prevent tarmac congestion.
Thousands of trucks enter the port terminal gates every morning to drop off export containers.
The modern all-in-one wireless POS terminal accepts chips, contactless Apple Pay, and barcode scans.
Passengers queued at the newly inaugurated airport departure terminal to check in their luggage.
System administrators execute configuration bash commands using the encrypted Linux command terminal.

This adjective can mean located at the end of something or relating to a final stage. As a noun, it can mean a station building, a computer screen for entering commands, or a connection point for wires. The word has several uses.
A train line ends at its final station. That last stop is the final point of the route. The adjective describes its position at the end.
An airport building handles arriving and departing passengers. A computer screen lets someone enter commands. The word has several noun meanings in travel and technology.
porter
The porter carried our bags to the room.
A porter helped the traveler at the station.
The porter waited beside the hotel entrance.
This noun names a person who carries bags for travelers at a hotel or station. The worker may help guests reach their rooms. The job involves carrying items.
It can also mean a person who carries goods or luggage as a job. A traveler may pay the worker for help. The term is common in older stories.
In sports, the word can name a player positioned near the goal. Context determines whether it means a worker who carries or a sports position. The role depends on the game.
suitcase
He packed his clothes in a suitcase.
The suitcase fit in the train's overhead rack.
She pulled her suitcase through the station.
This noun means a rectangular bag with a handle, used for carrying clothes when traveling. It usually opens with a zipper. A traveler can place it in a car or overhead bin.
The bag may have wheels or be carried by hand. It keeps clothing and personal items together. The word names a common travel bag.
A person may pack one for a short trip. It is smaller than many large travel cases. The noun describes the bag itself.
headphones
Sound designers use open-back reference headphones to evaluate subtle stereo panning and spatial reverb tails.
Commuters put on noise-canceling headphones to enjoy podcasts in quiet serenity on the crowded metro.
Studio tracking sessions require closed-back headphones to prevent headphone audio bleed into the open vocal mic.
Noise-canceling headphones help you concentrate in noisy cafes.
He placed his over-ear headphones on the desk after the podcast recording.
Wear stereo headphones to appreciate the subtle details of classical music.
This noun names a pair of small speakers worn over or in the ears. They let one person listen without playing sound aloud. They connect to a phone or computer.
A student may use them to hear a language lesson on a bus. Other passengers hear less noise. The device can be wired or wireless.
Different models cover the ears or fit inside them. They help people listen privately. The plural spelling is most common because the pair has two sides.
toothpaste
Squeeze a pea-sized amount of toothpaste onto the brush.
This fluoride toothpaste helps prevent cavities.
Buy a fresh tube of mint toothpaste from the supermarket.
It is a soft cleaning product used on a toothbrush. People use it to clean their teeth and freshen their breath. It often comes in a tube.
Put a small amount of this minty paste on a brush before cleaning your teeth. Some kinds contain fluoride to help protect against cavities. Rinse your mouth afterward.
This product helps remove food and plaque from teeth. It may have a mint flavor and is squeezed from a tube. Use it with a toothbrush each day.
flight attendant
The flight attendant served hot tea and meal trays.
Friendly flight attendants ensure passengers understand safety evacuation procedures clearly.
She dreamed of becoming an international flight attendant and traveling globally.
The attentive flight attendant assisted elderly passengers with overhead bags.
Flight attendants undergo rigorous emergency evacuation and first aid training before flying.
The polite flight attendant brought a warm blanket and a glass of water to the shivering traveler.
This airline worker helps passengers during a trip in the sky. They show people how to use safety equipment and may serve drinks. They work inside the plane.
Before takeoff, this crew member explains important safety steps. During a journey, they help travelers find their seats. They may bring meals or tea.
A person with this job cares for passengers on an airplane. They answer questions and keep the cabin safe. The role includes serving food and drinks.
receptionist
The friendly hotel receptionist handed us the electronic room key cards.
The dental clinic receptionist scheduled my next cleaning appointment.
The corporate receptionist greeted visitors warmly in the main lobby.
This worker welcomes visitors at the front desk of a hotel or clinic. The person may answer calls and arrange appointments.
When you arrive at an office, this staff member can tell you where to go. A friendly greeting is part of the job.
A hotel guest may ask this employee for a room key or directions. The worker handles questions at the entrance desk.
key card
Tap your electronic key card to open the hotel room door.
I accidentally demagnetized my key card by placing it near my phone.
Please return both key cards to the front desk when checking out.
Hold this plastic card near a reader to unlock a hotel room. It can replace a metal key.
A guest taps this card on a door sensor to enter. Keep it safe until checkout.
This access card may open a building or room with a quick tap. The front desk can give one to a visitor.
front desk
Ask the hotel front desk clerk for extra pillows and local sightseeing maps.
You can leave your luggage at the front desk before check-in time.
Dial zero on the room telephone to contact the 24-hour front desk.
This is the counter in a hotel where guests can ask for help or check in. Staff may provide pillows or maps. They are often available all day.
A visitor can leave luggage here before entering a room. Hotel workers answer questions at this counter. A room phone may connect directly to it.
This hotel area is usually near the entrance. Guests can get keys, ask for assistance, or call staff from there. It is an important place for service.
check in
Guests can check in to their hotel rooms starting from 3:00 PM.
Arrive at the airport three hours early to check in for your international flight.
We used our mobile phones to check in online twenty-four hours before departure.
Use this phrase when registering at a hotel or confirming you are taking a flight. A guest may do it at the front desk. Online options are common.
At an airport, travelers confirm their trip and receive a boarding pass. Hotel guests give their details when they arrive. This completes their arrival registration.
A traveler may register at a hotel and receive a room key. Airline passengers can confirm their flight by phone. The phrase has both travel uses.
overhead bin
Place your roller carry-on suitcase wheels-first into the overhead bin.
When the flight is completely full, flight attendants may ask you to check bags if overhead bins are packed.
Be careful when opening the overhead bin after landing, as heavy items might have shifted during flight.
It is a storage compartment above passenger seats on an airplane. Travelers place small bags inside. Open it carefully after landing because items may shift.
A cabin has these lockers over the rows of seats. A flight attendant may ask passengers to move bags if they are full. Keep heavy objects secure.
Passengers store carry-on luggage in this space above them. Put the suitcase in wheels first. Make sure it closes before takeoff.
airbridge
Passengers walked through the airbridge and stepped directly into the Boeing 787.
The climate-controlled airbridge shields travelers from torrential airport rainstorms.
Ground staff aligned the motorized airbridge flush against the aircraft door after parking.
This is a covered walkway that connects an airport building directly to an airplane door. Passengers can board without walking outside. Ground workers move it into place.
Travelers use this enclosed path to enter a plane from the terminal. It protects them from rain and heat. Staff align it after the aircraft parks.
Use this noun for the movable passage between a terminal and an aircraft. It is climate controlled. Passengers walk through it to board.
baggage cart
The worker puts two suitcases on the baggage cart.
A baggage cart waits beside the airplane.
The tug pulls a baggage cart across the airport.
This low wheeled trailer carries luggage around an airport.
Airport workers load suitcases onto this cart and move them to or from an airplane.
A small powered vehicle can pull this luggage trailer across the airport apron.
business class
Our business class seats have wide armrests.
She chooses business class for the long flight.
The flight attendant serves a meal in business class.
This airline travel class usually offers more space and services than economy class.
Passengers in this cabin often have wider seats and more room for their legs.
This is a premium seating class on an airplane, between economy class and first class when all three are offered.
economy class
Our family sits in economy class.
Economy class has rows of passenger seats.
He watches a film in economy class.
This is the standard seating class on a passenger airplane.
Seats in this cabin are usually arranged in rows with less space than business class.
This airline travel class usually costs less than business class.

narrationJobs.text: At the busy airport terminal, an airplane waits outside the window. A baggage cart carries suitcases outside. A passenger carries a heavy bag and waits in line near the gate. There is an empty seat beside the line. A clock hangs above a screen. A woman in a uniform checks each ticket. A boy shows his ticket to her. His family is ready to board the airplane through the passage inside the airbridge.

At the hotel front desk, guests check in with a friendly receptionist. One guest has a reservation and shows her passport. Another guest uses a pen to sign a form while the receptionist gives the woman a key card. A bell sits on the desk. Another guest asks, “Can I leave my luggage here?” A porter puts a tag on a suitcase and sets it on a cart. Beside the desk, travelers can have water, hot tea, or coffee in a cup. A nearby shelf holds a towel, soap, shampoo, a toothbrush, and toothpaste. A guest asks for a toothbrush, and another receptionist gives one to him.

On a sunny day, a large ship sails across the sea toward an island. A small boat passes near the ship. The captain is at the front, and a sailor works with a rope below a flag. A passenger sits on a bench with a bag beside him. It is windy, so he holds his hat. A child watches a wave beside the ship.

Inside the cabin, a passenger opens an overhead bin with luggage inside. In business class, the seats are wide and comfortable. A traveler eats a meal from a plate, while another seat holds a pillow and a blanket. Behind a curtain, economy class has narrow seats arranged in rows. One flight attendant serves a tray to a passenger beside a cart. The cart holds water, juice, and more meals. Another flight attendant pours juice into a cup. A passenger wears headphones and drinks from his cup. A magazine sits in a pocket below a screen. Clouds fill the view through each window, and the wing and engine are outside the cabin.

newGenerationProfile.instruct: Speak warmly and clearly, like a kindergarten English teacher. Use a gentle, encouraging tone and careful pronunciation.
